tasks.title: Correct the retained edge tab affordance
tasks.objective: Replace the detached outlined rail treatment with one narrow branded edge-attached tongue and make the retained panel's shadow follow retracted versus expanded state, without changing the existing panel geometry or interaction lifecycle.
tasks.outcome: Cue rests as a quiet recognizable tab emerging from the selected physical edge, remains reachable through the full 22×88 hit frame, and reveals exactly as before.
acceptance: A 16–18 point visible tongue sits inside the unchanged 22×88 hit frame, flush and square on the edge-facing side with only the inward side continuously rounded.
The canonical Cue app icon remains visible at count zero, queue count is secondary, and the chevron, full outline and retracted AppKit shadow are absent.
One Button retains the existing VoiceOver label, value and hint plus the current hover, click, focus, Reduce Motion, state-machine, multi-display and frame-persistence semantics.
Left/light/count-zero, right/dark/count-two and opaque fallback renders prove the edge context, brand hierarchy, single contour and transparent inward hit remainder.
Expanded and transitional panel shadow remains on, independent design/accessibility and AppKit/runtime reviews have no blocking findings, and full deterministic checks pass.

verification.proves: The full deterministic suite preserves panel behavior and exercises the actual retained NSPanel owner.
Static edge-context fixtures cover the required visual and fallback states.
Exact images and independent reviews map the final result to the design packet.
